newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-PIERCE CELEBRATES BIRTHDAY WITH VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-PIERCE CELEBRATES BIRTHDAY WITH VICTORY.

text.p: Former champion Mary Pierce celebrated her 22nd birthday on Wednesday with an easy win in the second round of the Australian Open and said she felt happier with her comeback form every day.
Frenchwoman Pierce won in Melbourne in 1995 but her game started to collapse soon afterwards and she was sidelined for several months last year because of a weak shoulder.
Pierce showed little weakness on Wednesday as she brushed past Ukrainian Natalia Medvedeva 6-2 6-2, earning a third-round berth against Germany's Marketa Kochta.
"I feel like my game is getting better and better," she said after cutting a birthday cake at a news conference. "I'm pretty happy, though I'm still not where I want to be."
